what: Ownership model vs measured %Drafted, and the refit that did not move it.

fit_set.note: one contest per slate, the largest field, matched by dfs.results.contest_night

ruled_out: lower temperature: MAE rises monotonically below 34; chalk bias barely moves
appeal weights: 1771-point simplex sweep x T in {30,40,50}; best MAE 4.652 vs shipped 4.669
z-score and min-max in place of the percentile transform: same MAE/chalk-bias frontier
raising MAX_OWNERSHIP: cap never binds at T=40 (40 -> 100 moves MAE by 0.05)
diagnosis: The residual is ranking quality, not sharpness. field_appeal ranks the field's chalk at Spearman 0.56 and recovers 4.1 of its top ten, so concentrating ownership concentrates it on the wrong player. At T=8 the model's top estimate averages 64% against a real 43% -- capability is not the limit, knowing who is.
would_move_it: the same player's measured ownership on recent slates
